FM12.reasoning: The agent combines the predictions using arbitrary, hardcoded weights without performing any optimization or tuning of the blending ratios using out-of-fold predictions.

other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage via Frequency Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Frequency encoding is calculated on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the categorical distribution statistics of the test set into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Missing Validation Score Calculation
other_failure_modes.description: The script uses cross-validation to train models and implements early stopping, but it fails to calculate or log the overall out-of-fold validation score. This makes it impossible to evaluate the models' performance locally.

summary: The agent implements a generally sound modeling pipeline with cross-validation and gradient boosting models. However, it introduces data leakage by computing frequency encoding on the combined train and test sets. Additionally, the ensembling relies on hardcoded, untuned weights, and the script entirely omits calculating or logging any out-of-fold validation metrics.
